name: AI Recruiter - Orchestrator Agent with Tools

parameters.content:
## 🧠 Orchestrator Agent + Recruitment Tools

A **single visible Orchestrator AI Agent** decides which tools to call and in what order — just like an autonomous AI agent.

**Tools connected to the Orchestrator:**
🔧 Extract Resume → 🔧 Analyze Skills → 🔧 Find Job Matches → 🔧 Screen Candidate → 🔧 Generate Recommendation

**Setup:**
1. Create **OpenAI API** credential with Nebius key + base URL
2. Assign to the model node
3. POST `resume_text` to webhook

> The Orchestrator autonomously decides tool order and combines results.

options.systemMessage: You are an AI Recruitment Orchestrator Agent. Your job is to process job applications by coordinating specialized recruitment tools. You MUST use ALL tools provided to you in a logical order. After using all tools, compile a complete recruitment assessment report. Always be thorough and systematic. Use tools to gather all necessary information before making any recommendations.

parameters.name: extract_resume
parameters.description: Extracts and structures information from raw resume text. Use this tool FIRST to parse the resume into structured data including personal info, education, work experience, technical skills, and certifications. Input: the raw resume text.

parameters.name: analyze_skills
parameters.description: Analyzes a candidate's extracted profile to determine technical skills, years of experience, education level, experience level (Junior/Mid-level/Senior), key achievements, and domain expertise. Use this tool SECOND after extract_resume. Input: the extracted profile JSON as text.

parameters.name: find_job_matches
parameters.description: Searches the current job market and generates realistic, up-to-date job listings that match the candidate's skills and experience level. Use this tool THIRD after analyze_skills. Input: JSON with candidate role and top skills.

parameters.name: screen_candidate
parameters.description: Performs a formal HR screening of the candidate against the matched job opportunities. Produces a detailed screening report with a score (0-100) and identifies any red flags. Use this tool FOURTH after find_job_matches. Input: JSON with candidate profile and job matches.

parameters.name: generate_recommendation
parameters.description: Generates the final hiring recommendation from a Senior HR Director perspective. This is the LAST tool to call — use it FIFTH after screen_candidate. Returns hiring status (Recommended/Not Recommended/Pending Review), justification, next steps, and confidence level. Input: complete candidate assessment data as JSON.
